messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — planned release tonight 23:00 UTC. Need alignment on API, runtime, console, router. I'll list what I think the order should be and the telemetry gates.
lee: +1. Post order pls. Are we still doing zero-downtime traffic split?
sanjay: Yes — router first to enable header-based routing, then runtime rollout, then API, finally console docs/flags. Router change is lightweight.
michele: Does runtime change include kernel selection change? That needs KV-cache warmup window.
anya: Runtime will flip kernel flag `fast-kernel-v2`. We need a 5m warmup and KV cache priming. Gate: latency p95 < 120ms for 5m.
robin: For API, we have schema bump (v2 fields). We should pin older version in Dedicated for 1h as fallback. Rollback trigger: >3% 5xx or schema errors.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduling wave: router(23:00) -> runtime(23:05) -> api(23:15) -> console(23:30). Canary sizes: router 5%, runtime 10%, api 10%, console 100% dry-run. See /deploy status.
lee: I'll update release notes with the API schema diff and example responses. Any doc break risk?
michele: console reads quota endpoints; keep quota feature flag on until API stable.
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder: change window approved. On-call: @sanjay @lee. Use channel #release-telemetry for alerts.
anya: Telemetry gates: - router error rate < 0.5% - runtime p95 < 120ms - api 5xx < 3% - end-to-end user-flow success > 98%. If any gate fails, automated rollback to previous pinned variants.
michele: We'll pre-run smoke job against staging with `curl -H 'x-trace: release23'` to prime caches.
robin: For version pinning: API: canary routes will prefer `api:v2026-03-21` and fall back to `api:stable` if errors > threshold.
lee: release notes: I'll add a note about KV priming and manual follow-up steps for SRE if rollback happens. :memo:
anya: Great. Last ask: everyone please push their rollout snippets to the release doc and tag @deploy-bot with `--hold` if you need a manual gate.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for router (5%) — healthy so far. metrics: error_rate 0.12%, p95 78ms. Next wave in 5m.
robin: Thanks — monitoring open. I'll watch API logs and schema validator.
sanjay: I'll be on standby for runtime roll forward/rollback. ping me if warmup stalls.
lee: ack. I'll post final release notes link here when done.
anya: :thumbsup: closing loop here unless someone needs a hold.
